subject: Vendr portal: SSO credential rotation & evidence inventory verification
messages:
-----Original Message-----
From: Sam Wheeler <sam.wheeler@vendr.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Reyes <olivia.reyes@acmeinc.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal: initial evidence manifest + SSO rotation window

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this. Two quick asks as we finish Vendr portal onboarding for Acme:

1) We need a compact manifest of the evidence artifacts you can provide for SIG / CAIQ scoping (SOC 2 cert PDF, encryption KMS policy, SSO SAML metadata, sample access logs for last 90 days). A CSV is ideal for our portal import.
2) Heads-up: our security ops team will rotate the SSO certs for the Vendr->Redwood SAML trust on Aug 4. Can you confirm the service account(s) that have access to the Redwood SSO metadata endpoint and who will validate the new cert?

I attached a blank manifest template to this note and a short note about the rotation window. If possible, can your team upload the completed manifest to the Vendr portal link below by EOD Aug 3?

Portal upload: https://vendr.app/upload/abcd-1234
Attachment: vendr_manifest_template.csv (CSV)
Attachment: sso-rotation-window.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that helps.

—Sam
Security Ops, Vendr


On Sun, 1 Aug 2027 at 10:03 AM Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wheeler <sam.wheeler@vendr.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 10:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: initial evidence manifest + SSO rotation window

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick answers and plan below.

Summary: we can provide a manifest with the following items: SOC2 Type II PDF (latest cert), SIG mapping CSV (we maintain a modular CAIQ mapping), encryption/KMS policy excerpt, a 90-day access-log sample (redacted), and SAML metadata for our IdP.

Owners and next steps:
- I will own the manifest upload (Grace O'Connor).
- Jonas will provide the SIG/CAIQ mapping CSV and a short note on controls that map to the Vendr questions.
- Evelyn will produce the 90-day redacted access logs and the KMS policy excerpt.

Requested timeline:
- Internal handoff: Aug 2 by EOD — all artifacts staged in our secure S3 handoff bucket.
- Upload to Vendr portal: Aug 3 by EOD (to hit your rotation window on Aug 4).

Questions for Sam:
- Does the portal accept zipped manifests, or should we upload individual files? (CSV + PDF preferred for our automation.)
- Who will be the validation contact on the Vendr side after you rotate the cert? Include name/email so we can schedule a smoke test of SAML immediately after.

Attachments: None on this reply.

Thanks —
Grace
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference


On Mon, 2 Aug 2027 at 08:27 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sam Wheeler <sam.wheeler@vendr.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 08:27:43 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: initial evidence manifest + SSO rotation window

Grace / Sam —

Attached is a first-pass SIG -> CAIQ slice for the Vendr portal import. I focused on authentication, access control, and logging sections (their questionnaire shows a lot of overlap there). Notes:

- The CSV has a column "portal_question_id" matching Vendr's import mapping and a "redwood_artifact" column that points to the artifact name in the manifest.
- For several items we reference our SOC2 report and the KMS policy excerpt (Evelyn: please confirm the policy file name when you stage files).
- I flagged three items that are partial: (1) long-term retention of some audit logs (we keep detailed logs for 12 months, aggregated for 36 months); (2) 3rd-party penetration test windows (last test summary is redacted, full report goes to NDA'd reviewers); (3) service account rotations cadence (we have quarterly rotation; Sam — is Vendr expecting monthly?).

Attachments: vendr_evidence_manifest_v1.csv (CSV)

-Jonas
Senior Security Engineer
